945bce6beaf99e9c.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن روضة طفلي النجيب الأهلية عن توفر شاغر مدير روضة في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق استراتيجية وأنشطة مركز رعاية الطفل، مع الإشراف على الموظفين والأطفال في مختلف برامج الرعاية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع الإستراتيجية العامة لمركز رعاية الطفل والإشراف على أنشطة تحديد الأسواق والمستخدمين المستهدفين، بالإضافة إلى تطوير خطط العمل المناسبة. إدارة العمليات اليومية التي تشمل الأنشطة الترفيهية والتعليمية، وتحضير الوجبات، وأعمال التنظيف الروتينية. تطوير وتنسيق البرامج الهادفة إلى تحسين النمو البدني، الاجتماعي، العاطفي، والفكري للأطفال. اختيار وتدريب الموظفين، والإشراف عليهم، ومراقبة أدائهم وسلوكهم بما يتماشى مع الأهداف المحددة. ضمان نظافة المرافق والمعدات وسلامة أدائها، والحفاظ عليها في حالة جيدة، بالإضافة إلى الإشراف على أعمال الصيانة الدورية والإصلاحات اللازمة. وضع السياسات والإجراءات لضمان الامتثال لقوانين ولوائح الصحة والسلامة والبيئة، والإشراف على تنفيذها. الإشراف والتنسيق يتولى مدير الروضة مسؤولية الإشراف المباشر على موظفي رعاية الطفل، وكذلك على الأطفال ضمن برامج الرعاية الصباحية (قبل المدرسة)، والمسائية (بعد المدرسة)، وفي الإجازات، ومراكز الرعاية النهارية. كما يشمل الدور الإشراف على تخطيط وإعداد المناهج التعليمية وتنفيذها لضمان جودة التعليم المقدم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة بإدارة مراكز رعاية الأطفال أو الروضات. القدرة على تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق الأنشطة التعليمية والإدارية. مهارات قيادية وإشرافية قوية. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة مكة المكرمة. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم على هذا الدور في روضة طفلي النجيب الأهلية.

94f3224c422b7f8d.description: Over 100,000 merchants run their businesses on Salla, and our next phase is expanding across the GCC and beyond. That expansion is not a copy-paste of what we built in Saudi Arabia. Each market has different payment rails, regulatory requirements, logistics realities, and merchant expectations. The product has to be adapted deliberately, not translated. This role owns that work, and it is the kind of seat that usually doesn't exist: The product decisions that make or break a market entry run through one person. You. You will make Salla work as well for a merchant anywhere in the GCC and beyond as it does in our home market: diagnosing where the product needs to change in each new market, deciding what gets built, adapted, or deferred, and driving the work from diagnosis to shipped improvement. You will drive impact across three major domains: Activation in New Markets (signup-to-first-order friction diagnosed and closed, with payments and know-your-customer compliance as the primary battleground) Market-Specific Product Fit (payments, logistics integrations, compliance workflows, and localization that make Salla feel native, not imported) Expansion Infrastructure (the shared product primitives and playbook that make the third market entry cheaper than the first) Responsibilities: Own the product roadmap for expansion across the GCC and beyond, one market at a time, with a clear line of sight to subsequent markets. Diagnose where and why merchants in each market drop off between signup and first order, and ship the product changes that close the gap. Drive the payment and compliance product work per market: know-your-customer flows, payment gateway integrations, regulatory requirements. Decide which parts of the core product need per-market adaptation and which stay shared infrastructure, and own where to invest. Define and monitor the metrics that reflect real market progress: time to first order, activation rate by market, ninety-day retention, share of merchants expanding regionally. Build the measurement framework from scratch where benchmarks don't exist, and separate real activation signal from noise. Lead cross-functional work across engineering, design, operations, legal, and local market teams without direct authority. Communicate tradeoffs, sequencing, and what is deliberately paused to protect focus. Proven experience owning product for a market expansion or geographic rollout at a software, fintech, or commerce platform, ideally one requiring adapted payments, compliance, or onboarding across regulatory environments. Deep understanding of merchant activation dynamics: diagnosing drop-off by market and the product changes that move activation rate in practice. Payments and know-your-customer fluency as a product problem, not a compliance checkbox: gateway integrations, document flows, and their product implications. Familiarity with Gulf market realities: payment methods, logistics infrastructure, value-added tax and commercial licensing, and how merchant behavior differs across the region. Track record improving time-to-value in a self-serve, low-touch environment where the product does the onboarding. Strong analytical instinct, comfortable building measurement for a market with no benchmarks. Experience leading cross-functional work without authority over the teams involved. Five or more years in product management, with meaningful ownership in an ambiguous or early-stage context. Arabic fluency is a must; Gulf residency or prior regional experience is preferred over theoretical market knowledge. Willing to relocate to Saudi Arabia.

942701ba6e27a4e3.description: About The Role Müller's Solutions is looking for a senior, hands-on Project Manager to lead the delivery of a SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition implementation for a major trading group based in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. You will take full ownership of a multi-legal-entity Finance and Supply Chain transformation — from Fit-to-Standard workshops through go-live and hypercare — working at the intersection of our client's leadership and a hybrid onsite/offshore delivery team. This is a high-visibility role within our Middle East practice. You will report directly to the Managing Director and act as the single point of accountability for scope, schedule, budget, and client satisfaction throughout the engagement. What You'll Own — End-to-end delivery of the S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition program using SAP ACTIVATE methodology, from Prepare through Run. — A delivery team spanning Finance, Supply Chain, Integration, Data Migration, and Training — coordinating onsite and offshore workstreams as one team. — The project plan, RAID log, budget tracking, and resourcing decisions across all phases. — Executive-level reporting and steering committee facilitation with client leadership across 4 legal entities. — Scope governance and change request management, protecting both project quality and commercial margin. — Cutover planning, go-live readiness, and hypercare oversight — ensuring the client lands the system successfully. — Coordination of ZATCA Phase 2 compliance milestones with the Finance workstream lead. — 8+ years of SAP project management experience, with full lifecycle accountability. — A minimum of 3 completed SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition go-lives as lead Project Manager. — SAP ACTIVATE methodology certification. — Demonstrated experience managing multi-legal-entity SAP deployments within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. — Confident, polished stakeholder management with C-level and finance leadership in Arabic-speaking business environments. — A track record of holding scope, budget, and timeline discipline on fixed-price or milestone-based engagements. Preferred — PMP or PRINCE2 certification. — Prior experience in trading, distribution, or manufacturing client environments. — Familiarity with SAP Integration Suite and BTP-based integration landscapes. — Work on flagship Cloud ERP transformations for some of the region's most respected enterprises, backed by a multi-vendor partner ecosystem spanning SAP, ServiceNow, OpenText, BMC, Boomi, and Red Hat. — A Berlin-headquartered firm with genuine regional depth — offices in Riyadh, Dubai, Cairo, and Casablanca, and an offshore delivery model that lets you focus on what matters most: the client. — Direct visibility and access to senior leadership — your impact on client outcomes is seen and valued, not buried in a large delivery hierarchy. — A culture that rewards ownership: you scope it, you lead it, you're credited for it.

94f60d49a5b1d0f4.description: Do you want to love what you do at work? Do you want to make a difference, an impact, transform people’s lives? Do you want to work with a team that believes in disrupting the normal, boring, and average? If yes, then this is the job you’re looking for. UXBERT Labs is one of the best digital and user experience design agencies in the GCC working with the biggest regional and international brands such as STC, Amazon, Gucci and more. UXBERT Labs is part of the Supertech Group also consisting of Hala Yalla, Saudi’s #1 private event ticketing and experience booking platform, and Kafu Games, the largest esports tournament platform in MENA. Lead iOS and Android development using React Native and TypeScript; set standards for code quality, testing, and reviews. ● Architect scalable, maintainable mobile solutions (state management, navigation, caching, offline-first and analytics). ● Deliver pixel-perfect UI from Figma with high-quality animations and consistent behaviour across devices. ● Own mobile release management: CI/CD, OTA updates (where applicable), store submissions, and post-release monitoring. ● Collaborate with backend teams on API contracts, performance, and reliability; ensure robust error handling and observability. ● Mentor and support engineers through sprints, planning, estimation, technical guidance, and 1:1 coaching. ● Report weekly to the Head of Engineering on progress, risks, and roadmap delivery. Must-have requirements ● 7+ years building mobile apps with 3+ years of production React Native experience at scale. ● Strong TypeScript and JavaScript fundamentals; proven ability to write clean, well-structured code (not just glue code). ● Deep mobile fundamentals: performance profiling, memory management, networking, offline storage, and app lifecycle. ● Hands-on experience with mobile CI/CD and release pipelines (Fastlane, EAS, GitHub Actions/Bitrise/CircleCI, etc.). ● Experience with OTA updates and feature flagging strategies. ● Excellent understanding of iOS/Android UX patterns and App Store / Play Store requirements. ● Leadership experience guiding a remote or cross-functional team; strong communication and accountability. Nice-to-have ● Expo (managed workflow) and EAS build experience. ● Node.js API familiarity (to collaborate effectively with backend teams). ● Advanced UI/graphics work (e.g., maps/GPS, charts, OpenGL/Canvas, animation-heavy experiences). ● Experience in fintech, loyalty, e-commerce, delivery/logistics, gaming or high-traffic consumer apps. ● PostgreSQL knowledge and data modelling awareness (helpful for end-to-end thinking). What we look for (craft + ownership) ● You sweat the details (pixel-perfect UI, clean diffs, reusable components, and consistent conventions). ● You are pragmatic: you choose the simplest architecture that will scale, and you know when to refactor. ● You ship reliably: predictable delivery, clear risk management, and high-quality releases. ● You can defend your technical decisions and document trade-offs. What to include in your application ● Links to shipped apps (App Store / Google Play) and/or GitHub/portfolio. ● A brief note on your most complex React Native project and what you owned end-to-end.

9427bcebb34a525d.job_title: Network Monitoring Analyst (ACI/F5 L1)-(Saudi National Only)
9427bcebb34a525d.description: Join our team at Müller's Solutions as a Network Monitoring Analyst (ACI/F5 L1) dedicated to supporting our network infrastructure in Saudi Arabia. This position is exclusively for Saudi Nationals and focuses on Providing foundational (L1) support for the SEC Data Center and Cloud Networks, with a specific focus on Cisco ACI and F5 load balancing technologies. This role operates on an 8x5 schedule with on-call responsibilities, focusing on monitoring, initial fault management, incident registration, and escalation to senior support teams. Key Responsibilities: Oversee the performance and health of the network utilizing Cisco ACI and F5 technologies, proactively identifying and addressing issues as they arise. Deliver first-level support for network-related incidents and service requests, ensuring prompt resolution and minimal impact on operations. Work in collaboration with engineering teams to facilitate the deployment and management of network configurations and policies. Regularly analyze network traffic and performance metrics to enhance system functionality. Record network operations, incidents, and resolutions for compliance purposes and future reference. Support network security by monitoring and addressing potential threats or vulnerabilities. Keep informed about best practices, trends, and technologies pertinent to application networking and monitoring. Actively monitor infrastructure alarms for ACI and F5 systems, performing initial fault management, which includes basic isolation, restoration, and notifications. Log issues identified through monitoring or reported by other teams. Engage in remediation activities according to established support guidelines and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Create, assign, and aid in the resolution of daily Level 1 incidents. Document known fault types in the knowledge base. Adhere to all essential operational processes, including fault/incident management, performance monitoring, and change control. Monitor network performance and assist in troubleshooting basic network issues. Collaborate closely with the monitoring tools team to optimize and contextualize infrastructure alarms. Communicate complex issues and escalate them to Level 2/3 engineers for resolution. Requirements: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 1-2 years of experience in network monitoring or support roles, preferably with Cisco ACI and F5 technologies. Ability to work 8x5 and provide on-call support. Strong attention to detail and ability to follow defined procedures (SOPs). Good communication skills for escalating issues and collaborating with teams. Good documentation skills. Basic understanding of networking principles, TCP/IP, and application delivery functionality. Familiarity with network monitoring tools and services. Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to analyze and resolve technical issues. Good communication and collaboration skills to work effectively within a team. Must be a Saudi National. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with load balancers, firewalls, and application performance management tools. CCNA or similar networking certification is a plus. Knowledge of ITIL practices is beneficial. Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and methodologies in network monitoring. Why Join Us: Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team. Competitive salary and benefits package. Exciting projects and innovative work environment.

948780b251b25eef.description: Eram Talent is seeking a Drilling Foreman to join our Unconventional Resources Drilling Department (URDD). Candidate primary role will be to supervise field operations of land Drilling and Workover rigs, engaged in carrying programmed work on deep or otherwise critical wells. Supervises and oversees the operations of a contract rig performing drilling or remedial work on wells ranging from 18,000 - 23,000 feet. Incumbent will ensure that the contractor performs the work in a safe and acceptable manner, and that the contractor meets all the obligations of his contract. Coordinates deliveries of well materials and equipment and ensures it is available when the rig is ready for it. Drilling Rig Foreman administers the contracts on sight and serves as the primary liaison between the company and the contractor. Responsibilities Ensure all rig personnel and service providers are complaining with Saudi Aramco safety standards and requirement. Supervises and oversees all operations performed on wells. Makes recommendations on alternative methods or equipment when unusual situations are encountered. Coordinates deliveries of materials to the well to ensure it is available when required. Ensures that contractor meets all requirements of his contract. Works with Drilling and Workover engineers to see that modern drilling practices are followed. Approves contractor daily tour report. Ensures that contractor rig and equipment are properly maintained to avoid downtime. Performs other miscellaneous duties as directed by Supt. Ensures that Saudi Aramco Blowout Prevention Standards are met in all respects including equipment configuration, testing and crew response. Assures that rig and personnel comply with Saudi Aramco established safety standards and procedures. Minimum of 7 years of experience working in drilling and workover operations including adequate supervisory experience on a drilling or workover rig. Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field is preferred; Extensive knowledge of drilling equipment, techniques, and safety measures; Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills; Ability to work in high-pressure environments and make quick decisions; Willingness to work in remote locations and harsh weather conditions.
